text: In accordance with Section B.3. of the Terms of Reference of the Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee, the Committee will elect a member of the public as Co-Chair.

The Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee: 1. Elected Serge Paul as Co-Chair of the Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee for a term of office starting on February 11, 2020 and ending on December 31, 2020, and until a successor is appointed.
